newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments wins $43.9 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments wins $43.9 mln contract.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc said on Monday it was awarded a $43.9 million contract over the next five years from the U.S. Navy for the engineering and manufacturing development of a naval projectile.

The cost-plus-incentive fee/award fee contract was awarded by the Naval Sea Systems Command in Virginia for the development of the EX 171 Extended Range Guided Munitions projectile, the company said. The project was expected to be completed by September 2001, it said.
The projectile would be fired from guns aboard U.S. Navy ships. Unlike projectiles currently used by the Navy, this one used a global positioning system to navigate to the target.
